newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-RIGA SHIPYARD MAKES '96 PROFIT, Q1 LOSS.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-RIGA SHIPYARD MAKES '96 PROFIT, Q1 LOSS.

text.p: Riga Shipyard, to be quoted on the bourse's official list from May 5, said its 1996 profit came to 183,855 lats and it registered a first quarter loss of 51,220 lats, the stock exchange said on Friday.
Net turnover in 1996 was 12.05 million lats and production costs were 10.62 million lats, the bourse said, but gave no comparative figures.
"Riga shipyard first quarter profit came to 68,219 lats and it paid property tax worth 43,836 lats and profit tax of 75,603 lats," the bourse said in a statement.
"Thus the company in the first quarter of this year has no after-tax profit," the statement said.
"The company could not carry out ship repairs intensively during the first quarter due to weather conditions," Riga Shipyard technical direstor Anatoly Ustinov said in a statement.
The company shows a balance sheet value of 10.89 million lats for the first quarter.
On the asset side, the shipyard has 3.47 million lats of stocks, debtors of 1.40 million lats and cash of 222,786 lats.

Among liabilities, Riga Shipyard has 10 million lats of own capital, undivided profit from previous years of 183,855 lats and losses of 51,220 lats as the undivided profit of the accounting year, the bourse said.
It gave no comparative figures for the first three months of 1996.
Riga Shipyard also registered 763,587 lats of short-term liabilities for the first three months of 1997.
